activities.description: KiDi sits at a grand piano, struggling to compose music.
He crumples up sheet music in frustration and throws it away.
KiDi looks at his laptop, seeing comments from fans.
He checks his phone and confirms a money transfer using the Fidelity Bank app.
KiDi listens to a voice message from his mom confirming she received the money.
KiDi resumes playing the piano with renewed focus and a smile.
